title: Key setup gets its own wide panel
caption: On desktop, opening Key setup now widens the drawer into a panel: the grid on the left, the macro and notes on the right, and the page stays readable beside it. Esc or Back to Build returns to the drawer.

title: Pick a key on a phone
caption: At level 27 on a phone, tapping the E key opens a picker of keys you can bind in game. Keys another stack uses say which one, and you can type any other key.
